[head=2][color=#e8b04b]Gamemodes[/color][/head]
The selected gamemode determines [bold]which factions and jobs are available, which stations and ships spawn, and what kind of round is being played[/bold]. Always check the lobby's selected preset before preparing a character.
[color=#8fc98a]Respawn time is 5 minutes in every mode.[/color]
[head=3][color=#e8b04b]Freeplay variants[/color][/head]
Freeplay is the open-ended 2-4 hour sandbox. Trade, patrol, exploration, diplomacy, raids, and war are driven by players and round events. Several Freeplay maps appear in the vote:
- [bold]Freeplay[/bold]: the broad multi-faction preset. - [bold]Freeplay | DSM & NCWL[/bold]: the default, focused on the two major military powers. - [bold]Freeplay Balreska[/bold]: the same matchup with the League based at Nova Balreska. - [bold]Freeplay | TFCF & SHI[/bold]: the Federation and Shinohara contest the frontier.
[color=#8fc98a]For a first round, use the default DSM/NCWL preset and choose Freeholder or Union Worker.[/color] The TFCF and Shinohara variant needs faction playtime before its main jobs unlock.
[head=3][color=#e8b04b]Hyperwar | NCWL vs DSM[/color][/head]
DSM and NCWL fight over the central asteroid belt with the surrounding ring removed. SHI and TFCF are closed. Expect fleet actions, boarding, and ground pushes early in the round.
[color=#d9776c]This is a war-focused preset, not an OOC deathmatch.[/color] Even in an immediate war round, stay in character and follow the escalation and round-removal requirements in the [textlink="Roleplay Rules" link="RoleplayRules"].
[head=3][color=#e8b04b]Unionfall | NCWL vs DSM[/color][/head]
Unionfall is a scripted battle with its own roster. The NCWL Homeguard aboard the Clementine is intercepted by a DSM punishment regiment aboard the Nemesis.
Standard station jobs are closed. Both sides use dedicated Cadet, Rifleman, Doctor, Officer, Leader, Ship Captain, and Ship Crew roles.
[head=3][color=#e8b04b]Planetfall[/color][/head]
Planetfall is a ground-focused scenario in Count Olywier Rabenau's charter. Standard station jobs are closed and the mode uses its own Imperial, MVD, worker, partisan, medical, court, Freeholder, Oathbound, and Levyman roles.
[color=#6ab7d6]Hyperwar and Planetfall are not in the public vote; staff start them.[/color]
